description: Golden samples of the ABMeter API error envelope. `body` is the raw response body; `expected` is what every SDK error class must read from it. A null `message` means the SDK picks its own fallback text.

samples.name: with_details
samples.body: {"error":"Bad request","details":{"slug":["can only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens"]}}

slug: can only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

samples.name: with_code
samples.body: {"error":"Monthly active items limit reached (500,000/500,000). Limit resets on the 1st of next month. If this limit blocks a real experiment, write to support@abmeter.com.","code":"quota_exceeded","details":{"current":500000,"limit":500000}}

expected.message: Monthly active items limit reached (500,000/500,000). Limit resets on the 1st of next month. If this limit blocks a real experiment, write to support@abmeter.com.

samples.name: partial_failure
samples.body: {"error":"Failed to process 2 out of 3 events","details":{"recorded_count":1,"invalid_count":2,"failures":[{"index":1,"error":"Event type 'missing' not found"},{"index":2,"error":"Missing required fields: user_id"}]}}

expected.message: Failed to process 2 out of 3 events
